merge_rules.by-id: List section. Overlay omitted: inherit. Overlay []: clear. Non-empty: entries merge by id; an overlay entry with a known id is merged field by field over the default entry (nested objects deep-merge, scalars and plain lists are replaced, the project wins); a new id is appended. Entries can be removed through disabled.
merge_rules.add-only: List section that holds hard rules. Overlay omitted: inherit. The overlay may append entries with new ids; it may not clear the section, replace an existing id, or disable an entry (hard rules outrank everything below them).
merge_rules.deep: Map section. Overlay omitted: inherit. Overlay object: deep-merged over the default (the project wins on scalars and plain lists; lists of objects with ids merge by id; [] clears a list).
merge_rules.subtract: The disabled list: entries {section?, id, reason} merge by (section, id), then each named entry is removed from its by-id section after the merge. A reason is required. section may be omitted when the id exists in exactly one by-id section.
